d: The Supreme Court on November 2, 2026, permitted the manufacture, sale, and bursting of certified green firecrackers in Delhi-NCR for Deepavali on November 7 and 8. A Bench of Justices M.M. Sundresh and Prasanna B. Varale directed that fireworks will be restricted to two designated time slots: 6 to 7 AM and 8 to 10 PM. Fireworks remain strictly prohibited within 300 meters of hospitals, nursing homes, old age homes, and educational institutions.
